summary: Shared lane because src/L5R.Core/MatchQueries.cs (the legal-action offering the client renders) changes alongside the rules engine: the additional-action reaction window now lists a player's out-of-play Reactions from the same OutOfPlayReactions list that decides whether the window opens, so a Discipline Reaction in a discard pile is offered as the paid play instead of the window opening with nothing to click; for every card that exists today (Effortless Counterattack, hand only) the offered list is identical. No client or UI code changed. Rules change: out-of-play Reaction windows now open only when a card can really be played from where it is. AnyOutOfPlayReactionAvailable counted any hand or Fate-discard copy with the trigger, so a played Effortless Counterattack (now in the Fate discard pile) kept opening an additionalActionReaction window on every later additional action in the battle, and the same false window opened for played Strategies on the Attack window (A Close Call, Trusting Instinct, Strong Defenses) and for in-play-only Reactors (Akodo Kakihara, Khol Regulars, Flesh-Cutter Arrows) held in hand. ValidateAbility's source-zone rule is extracted into one AbilitySourceZoneAllows shared by ValidateAbility, a new OutOfPlayReactions list behind the availability check, and that offer, so the window and the offer cannot disagree. A discard-pile copy counts only where ValidateAbility allows it: Singh Remnants' hand-or-discard triggers (unchanged) and Discipline abilities (new training-discipline-counter fixture). Decision: keep the helper consistent with ValidateAbility rather than stricter.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes on the rebased branch (Python tools tests 43 and 132 OK; L5R.Core.Tests 216 core + 59 published + every suite incl. 6/6 new out-of-play-reaction-window; L5R.AI.Tests 27/27; Server and Transport tests passed). The new tests fail on the unfixed engine (the played Counterattack window reopens; Kakihara in hand opens an Attack window) and pass with the fix; the discard-pile Singh Remnants test is unchanged and passes. Mutation check of the fix, full Core suite per mutant: 8 of 10 killed at once (rule ignored, hand-only, Dynasty discard dropped, Strategy Discipline/discard, non-Strategy hand copy, Strategy in Fate discard, Singh trigger exception, offer back to hand-only); owner-filter dropped SURVIVED and was closed with a new assertion (a Discipline copy in the acting player's own discard pile), then killed; dropping the Attach-Self hand clause survives because ValidateAttach repeats the same hand-only check (equivalent mutant). A catalog sweep of every Reaction ability, old rule vs new, showed Singh Remnants and its fixture unchanged and no published discard-pile Reaction lost.
remaining: Two adjacent problems found and NOT fixed here: (1) Unimpeachable Name (a Strategy, before-any-action-resolves) is still playable from the Fate discard pile because ValidateAbility's trigger exception lists it alongside Singh Remnants; (2) the attackReaction window in QueryActions lists only in-play Reactors, so a hand-held A Close Call opens the window but is never offered (the existing test hand-builds that command). Otherwise none; ready for review.
